name: Question 11
worked_solution:
Multiplying each row in the first matrix by each column in the second, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}[\begin{aligned}-1 & 3 & -3 \\ 6 & 0 & 1 \\ 0 & 1 & -2\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}0 & -2 & -4 \\ -2 & 1 & -3 \\ -5 & 0 & 3\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}0-6+15 & 2+3+0 & 4-9-9 \\ 0+0-5 & -12+0+0 & -24-0+3 \\ 0-2+10 & 0+1+0 & 0-3-6\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}9 & 5 & -14 \\ -5 & -12 & -21 \\ 8 & 1 & -9\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$
